_howto: Add a new entry at the TOP for every release. 'v' must match the version in data.js and sw.js. Keep notes short and in plain language: they are shown to colleagues when an update is available.

notes: New look for the Bangkok Sidekick title at the top
Home: Bangkok Sidekick is proudly supported by Allianz Technology Thailand
Eat: Have A Zeed (Central Rama 9, 7th floor), our favourite, now at the top of In the mall
App Store and Google Play buttons no longer have a white box around them
Eat: added Somyong Tumsua 2, a local som tam favourite near G Tower and Belle Grand Rama 9
Photos added for Somboon Seafood and the MBK food court
Eat: 17 named restaurants and food halls added, including ones inside malls (Central Rama 9, Siam Paragon, Terminal 21, ICONSIAM, Central Embassy, CentralWorld)
Eat cards now show a photo of the restaurant when a free photo of that exact place exists
New Light / Dark mode button at the top right. Light is the default and your choice is remembered
Glass look is now more liquid: clearer, shinier glass with a softly moving background
Removed the LINE MAN button on Eat cards because it opened the app download page instead of the restaurant
Removed the general Indian search card from Eat
Eat has a new Indian section with restaurant picks
Restaurants now have Map, Wongnai and LINE MAN buttons. The LINE MAN button copies the restaurant name so you can paste it into the app search
The Street Ratchada now has its own photo
Photos are cleaner now: the small “i” and the photo credits list are gone
Fortune Town now has its own photo
Photos now load right away instead of waiting until you scroll to them
New, clearer photo of CentralWorld
Explore now has a photo for every place, all in the same size, with a cleaner minimal card design
Tap the small “i” on a photo to see who took it. Photos are saved on your phone for offline use
The update message now says how many updates you are behind, and lists the recent updates
When you are up to date it says “You're running the latest version”
Behind-the-scenes improvements (no visible changes)
New: when a newer version is available you now see what changed before you update
New: a quick “You're on the latest version” note when the app is up to date
Behind-the-scenes improvements (no visible changes)
New: an orange Update button appears at the top right when a newer version is ready
The app no longer reloads by itself; it waits until you tap Update
Fixed the browser-tab and iPhone icons so they use the real Bangkok Sidekick logo
New Bangkok Sidekick logo (the mango pin) in the header and as the app icon
Tips: added the SuperRich exchange office reported at Central Rama 9 (5th floor)
Popular Malls, Walkable and Near (MRT) now list the closest places first
Cards without a rating now have a “Tap to see Google rating” link
Popular Malls: 7 more malls added, and every card now shows its distance from the hotel
